title.narrative: Managing integrated TB/HIV response in Papua New Guinea

description.narrative: Papua New Guinea - TB/HIV - World Vision (PNG) Trust - WV Papua New Guinea. This program has the following goals: End the TB epidemic in Papua New Guinea by 2035. An efficiently managed, capable and well–resourced national, provincial and district response to STIs and HIV. A successful response to STIs and HIV that is driven by accurate and up–to–date strategic information and research. Decreased STI and HIV transmission and improved health and well–being of PLHIV. An environment that is safe and supportive of people’s efforts to remain healthy.. The objectives of this program are: By 2025, ninety percent (90%) of people with TB provided with universal drug susceptibility tests.. By 2025, to have achieved at least eighty-five percent (85%) treatment success rates for all forms of TB.. By 2025, at least ninety-five percent (95%) of patients with TB tested and know their HIV status.. By 2025, the technical and managerial capacities of the TB and HIV Programs at the national, regional, provincial and district levels for the provision of quality TB services are strengthened.. By 2025, more than eighty percent (80%) of key population are provided with comprehensive package of HIV prevention services.. By 2025, more than ninety percent (>90%) of PLHIV are initiated into highly efficacious anti-retroviral therapy. By 2025, key populations and PLHIV have mechanisms to prevent, share/report and duty bearers to respond to incidents of stigma, discrimination and other human right-related violations.. By 2025, more than ninety-five percent (>95%) of basic reporting units of the TB and HIV programs have on-time submission of quality-assured strategic information and surveillance reports.. By 2025, more than ninety-five percent (>95%) of pregnant mothers attending ANC clinics provided with MTCT services.. By 2025, ninety percent (90%) of PLHIV are virally suppressed.

Percentage of laboratories showing adequate performance in external quality assurance for smear microscopy among the total number of laboratories that undertake smear microscopy during the reporting period
